properties.name: PLANNED — seams become trustworthy before they become work. The instruments that report the seam picture were wrong in both directions: the roll-up dropped 58 of 86 modules and answered a FALSE ZERO, and the module-level band reports a ratio over a population it never names. Fix the instruments, then re-read what they say. NO VERSION NUMBER BY DESIGN (dec:idea-a-planned-increment-is-named-by-content-not-by-number). Supersedes epoch:v0270-planned.
